_doc: Agency economy (GDD section 12 and appendix C). Government budget paid at the start of every year from year 2: G = gov_budget[era] * (0.5 + reputation/100) * (1 + gov_milestone_step * milestones). Hype donations every month. Ledger keeps the last ledger_months closed months. Three month-ends with negative cash: the government steps in and offers a loan (loan_base * era_mult[era]) repaid in loan_months instalments at loan_rate_month interest.

bankruptcy._doc: The end of the money (src/tycoon/finance/bankruptcy.gd). The line is -X: X = the difficulty's bankrupt_line (difficulty.json, credits in era 1; default_line when a level has none) x era_mult[era]. Past warn_fraction of the line: warnings (HUD, Tail Radio, Vovo Halleyzinho). A month that ends past the line the first time: one emergency loan of the debt past zero plus cushion x X, repaid in months instalments at rate_month; the agency goes bankrupt when a month ends past the line again or when it ends default_months months in a row past the warning line before the loan is paid (a default).
